newsitem.title: USA: Browning-Ferris Q4 net loss vs profit.
newsitem.headline: Browning-Ferris Q4 net loss vs profit.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: 1996 Q4 includes pre-tax special charges of $447 million, or $362 million ($1.80 a share) after tax, due to decisions to sell Italian operations, divest non-core assets, close recycling facilities and write down Azusa, Calif. landfill.
1996 full year results also include after-tax extraordinary item of $0.06 a share loss in the second quarter related to the redemption of the $745 million of convertible subordinated debentures.
Excluding the special charges, 1994 Q4 operating income was a profit of $0.33 a share, or a profit of $67 million.
Before the special charges and the extraordinary item, 1996 fiscal year operating income was $273 million or $1.36 a share.
